'''2013 Worlds Day 2 RSmith LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[RSmith]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' Conway East
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
